items.title: US Spot Bitcoin ETF Daily Net Flows ($ millions)
items.description: Daily net flows of US spot Bitcoin ETFs in $ millions. The latest rows show four straight days of outflows, Nov 17 to Nov 20 (-$240M, -$307M, -$582M, -$669M).
items.reason: Bitcoin bounced back above $63,000 today after the weekend low near $55,100, and traders say today's ETF flows are the first test of whether the rebound holds.

items.title: Neocloud Stocks: 2026 Return YTD
items.description: 2026 year-to-date return of six neocloud stocks through the Nov 20 close: Nebius -2.9%, TeraWulf -14.3%, CoreWeave -44.8%, Applied Digital -53.1%, Cipher -63.2% and IREN -68.7%.
items.reason: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang this morning and neocloud and miner-turned-AI stocks jumped 15% to 30% or more, so this shows how deep a hole they were bouncing from.

items.title: Strategy's STRC buybacks as a share of weekly STRC volume
items.description: Strategy's weekly STRC buybacks as a share of weekly STRC trading volume, from the week of Jul 20 through Nov 16 (peaking near 30% of volume in early October).
items.reason: Strategy's Monday 8-K disclosed a 457 BTC purchase and a $212M STRC repurchase last week, so this puts the new buyback in the context of its months-long program.

items.title: Bitcoin miners that pivoted to AI data centers vs MARA and bitcoin (Dec 29 2023 = 100)
items.description: Equal-weight index of AI-pivot bitcoin miners IREN, CIFR and WULF versus MARA and bitcoin, rebased to 100 on Dec 29 2023 on a log scale.
items.reason: Miners led today's crypto-stock rally (IREN up about 29%, American Bitcoin, Hut 8 and MARA up 15%+), and this chart shows how far the AI-pivot group has run ahead of pure bitcoin miners.

items.title: "Net liquidity": Fed balance sheet minus Treasury cash (TGA) and reverse repo vs the S&P 500
items.description: Fed net liquidity (balance sheet minus Treasury cash and reverse repo, in $ trillions) plotted against the S&P 500 since 2019.
items.reason: Stocks had their worst week in 18 months before today's snap-back, and Bessent warned Sunday that the Fed could make a policy mistake if it over-tightens before the Dec 8-9 meeting.
